verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for an online filing platform, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows the Guichet unique offers this. The evidence covers only interactive web access (FranceConnect+, qualified e-signature certificates) and payment delegation for mandataires, not scoped or least-privilege API tokens for agents. The keyless recherche-entreprises API is a separate state service, and it uses no credentials at all.
